### Question 5: Meta-Prompting

This question uses the OpenAI Scaling Laws paper we discussed in class: <https://arxiv.org/abs/2001.08361>

**Part A — Without meta-prompting:**

1. Read the abstract of the paper (available at the link above)
2. Ask an LLM: *"Summarise this paper: [upload the paper PDF]"*
3. Copy the summary you receive

**Part B — With meta-prompting:**

1. Ask an LLM: *"I want to write a prompt that summarises research paper effectively. What information should I include in my prompt?"*
2. Use that advice to write an improved summarisation prompt
3. Use your improved prompt on the SAME paper
4. Copy the new summary

**Part C — Analysis:**

Compare the two summaries. What is different? Which is more useful and why?
